# WM Prototype NDA Gate

> WordPress plugin that asks logged-in users to accept a confidentiality agreement at login (after the password check), before wp-admin and frontend pages and on REST routes, and keeps every acceptance in an HMAC-chained register with a sealed tip, verification and CSV/JSON export. Anonymous visitors are not gated; the plugin makes no legal assessment.

## Overview


- REST: `wm-nda/v1` — `POST /accept`, `GET /verify`, `GET /register-integrity` (administrators), `GET /active-terms`
- WP-CLI: `wp nda status`, `list`, `verify`, `demodaten`, `retention`, `wasserzeichen-lesen`, `wasserzeichen-probe`
- Block Bindings & GenerateBlocks: `wm-nda/status` (WP 6.5+) and `{{wm_nda_status}}` (GenerateBlocks 2.x)
- Storage: `wp_wm_nda_terms`, `wp_wm_nda_acceptances`, options `wm_nda_register_tip` (sealed), `wm_nda_cache_salt`, `wm_nda_delete_data_on_uninstall` (opt-in uninstall, default `0`)
- Documentation measured against the code on 2026-09-15: README.md, DEVELOPERS.md, docs/
- Version 1.3.4.

## Standards

- PHP 8.2+ with strict types in every shipped file; WordPress coding style
- Zero-CDN Invariant (self-hosted assets in `/assets/`)
- Nonce & Capability Verification / Late Escaping
- Standalone test suite with a mutation check; read-only runtime check inside WordPress
